formula: For each case, median(C)/median(baseline)-1; arithmetic mean of the three case-relative changes. Only complete case matrices enter equal-weight totals. Negative means lower measured duration.
limits: Descriptive small samples, no significance/P95/noninferiority claim
Process execution includes rejected outputs and is not qualified delivery latency
Active work includes review work but excludes queue gaps and separately disclosed shared work
Dispatch-to-acceptance wall includes review scheduling and cold preparation confounds
Development environment-affected pairs are retained, not used for causal latency attribution
